articles.title: ChatGPT现在能生成GIF动图了
articles.summary: ChatGPT新增GIF生成功能，输入文字或上传照片即可制作动图，还能调速度、逐帧修改。
articles.why: 做表情包、课堂演示或社交媒体内容更方便，不用再开别的软件。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 试试用一张自己的照片生成动图，感受AI对图像的理解。
articles.for_me: 可以用它把英语学习场景做成小动图，比如展示一个单词的用法变化。
articles.source_title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs

articles.title: 国行Apple智能开放测试
articles.summary: iOS 27.3 Beta带来国行版Apple智能，部分功能已可上手体验，具体细节见实测文章。
articles.why: iPhone用户终于能试用苹果的AI功能，值得看看哪些功能真正好用。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 如果你用iPhone，可以关注测试版里哪些AI功能对你日常最实用。
articles.source_title: 国行 Apple 智能上手：这些功能已经准备好
articles.new_development: 国行Apple智能随iOS 27.3 Beta开放测试，部分功能可上手

articles.title: 高通押注数据中心业务
articles.summary: 手机芯片销量下滑约20%，高通在财报会上宣布通过亚马逊、Meta等合作进军AI数据中心。
articles.why: 芯片巨头转向AI基建，说明算力需求仍在扩张，可能影响未来AI服务价格。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 关注AI算力竞争如何间接影响你用的AI工具是否变快或变便宜。
articles.source_title: Qualcomm is betting big on data centers as smartphone sales sink

articles.title: 美国选民反对社区建数据中心
articles.summary: 中期选举后多地公投限制数据中心扩张，NBC民调显示76%受访者反对在自家社区建设。
articles.why: AI基建遭遇地方阻力，可能拖慢数据中心建设，进而影响AI服务供给和价格。
articles.beginner_takeaway: AI不只在屏幕里，它背后的电和水正在成为现实议题。
articles.source_title: 美国 AI 扩张遭遇地方阻力：水电资源和环境争议升温，76% 选民反对在社区建设数据中心

articles.title: Gemini接入AT&T家庭安防
articles.summary: AT&T智能家居安防系统接入Gemini for Home，可摘要家庭事件、搜索录像历史。
articles.why: AI助手开始进入家庭安防场景，普通人能直观感受AI如何理解视频内容。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 想想AI看家护院时，你最在意它帮你总结什么信息。
articles.source_title: Gemini for Home now plugs into AT&T’s smart security system

articles.title: Nothing将推无屏AI设备
articles.summary: Nothing CEO宣布12月发布首款AI设备，主打无屏幕设计，具体功能尚未公布。
articles.why: 手机厂商探索AI硬件新形态，值得观察无屏交互是否真的实用。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 没有屏幕的AI设备，你觉得它能帮你做什么？
articles.source_title: Nothing teases a screen-free AI device ahead of launch next month

articles.title: 苹果削减内部AI预算
articles.summary: 据报道苹果大幅削减工程团队使用AI的预算，具体金额未披露。
articles.why: 苹果在AI投入上收紧，可能影响其AI功能推进速度，值得持续观察。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 大公司对AI的态度并不一致，别把“所有公司都在猛投AI”当默认前提。
articles.source_title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage

articles.title: Uber称几乎没人用AI代理叫车
articles.summary: Uber表示最忙的一周里只有4个人用AI代理完成叫车，说明该功能实际使用率极低。
articles.why: 提醒我们AI代理听起来酷，但离日常真正好用还有距离。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 看到“AI代理帮你做事”的宣传时，可以多问一句：真有人用吗？
articles.source_title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says

articles.title: 启元T1机器人首次OTA升级

articles.why: 家用机器人开始通过软件更新获得新能力，其中口语练习功能对英语学习者有参考价值。
articles.beginner_takeaway: 机器人靠OTA升级变聪明，关注它新增的口语练习功能是否好用。
articles.for_me: 如果你有练习英语口语的需求，可以留意这类机器人接入的AI口语功能。
articles.source_title: 启元 T1 机器人首次 OTA 明日推送：智能识别楼梯并自动变形、远程音视频通话

items.title_en: Route Anything: A Study of Model and Policy Routing for General-Purpose AI Systems
items.summary: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) requires a method that can understand, generate, reason, and act across diverse domains and modalities. Rather than relying on a single model to master every capability, a promising path toward AGI now is to orchestrate a heterogeneous ecosystem of specialized models, tools, and policies (candidates) into a unified AI system. At the heart of this vision lies a fundamental question: how can an AI system dynamically select and coordinate the most capable candi
items.title_cn: 路由一切：面向通用AI系统的模型与策略路由研究
items.note: 提出把多个专用模型、工具和策略编排成统一系统，并研究如何动态选择最合适的候选。

items.title_en: Words Caught in the Heart: Simulating Person-Specific Expression for Self-Opaque Clients in Psychotherapy
items.summary: Psychotherapy clients may experience distress before they can coherently describe it, and their expression changes with emotion, perceived safety, and trust. Large language model-based client simulators often rely on clinically organized case descriptions, which can encourage responses explaining the client's difficulties more clearly than their current understanding warrants. We propose Pandora, a psychotherapy client simulation framework that models how psychological experience becomes situate
items.title_cn: 心中之言：为自我认知不清的来访者模拟个体化表达
items.note: 提出Pandora框架，模拟心理治疗来访者的表达如何随情绪、安全感和信任变化。

items.title_en: Think Less, Locally: Local Preference Learning for Reasoning Compression
items.summary: Large reasoning models achieve strong performance on challenging tasks, but their long chain-of-thought often incurs substantial inference costs by continuing to deliberate after sufficient information has been obtained. Existing reasoning compression methods primarily operate on reasoning trajectories, paying less attention to the local decision of whether further reasoning is necessary given the current state. We propose LoCo, a local preference learning method for reasoning compression. LoCo
items.title_cn: 少想一点，就地判断：用于推理压缩的局部偏好学习
items.note: 提出LoCo方法，学习在当前状态下是否还需继续推理，以减少冗长的思维链。

items.title_en: MoviEdit: Long-form Multi-Shot Video Editing Made Easy
items.summary: Long-form multi-shot video editing requires an intended edit to remain coherent across abrupt changes in scene, viewpoint, and subject appearance, while processing substantially longer visual context than conventional single-shot editors. We introduce MoviEdit, an end-to-end framework for scalable long-form multi-shot video editing that jointly addresses the challenges of data, modeling, and evaluation. To provide cross-shot supervision data at scale, we develop automatic data-generation pipelin
items.title_cn: MoviEdit：让长视频多镜头编辑变简单
items.note: 提出端到端框架，解决长视频多镜头编辑中跨场景、视角和主体变化的连贯性问题。

items.title_en: DreamX: Video Diffusion Model is a Universal Latent Action Learner
items.summary: Learning a universal action representation from video requires modeling dynamics that are consistent across different executions of the same action yet invariant to changes in embodiment and appearance. Existing latent action models infer actions from visual transitions, but their representations often entangle the underlying action with irrelevant visual variations, limiting transfer across embodiments. We introduce DreamX, which repurposes a pretrained video diffusion model as a universal late
items.title_cn: DreamX：视频扩散模型是通用潜在动作学习器
items.note: 把预训练视频扩散模型改作通用潜在动作学习器，减少动作表示与无关视觉变化的纠缠。

items.title_en: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
items.summary: Computer graphics is built on code. Large language model (LLM) agents can now generate graphics code and iteratively refine it through various feedback. This capability opens the door to a potentially new paradigm of computer graphics, with graphics algorithms increasingly built around agentic systems to automate progressively complex tasks. Over the past years, research on agentic graphics has expanded rapidly across a diverse range of tasks. This rapid growth makes it increasingly difficult fo
items.title_cn: 智能体计算机图形学进展
items.note: 综述LLM智能体生成并迭代改进图形代码的研究，梳理这一新范式的进展。

items.title_en: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
items.summary: Real-time long-video generation requires continuous output with consistent appearance and natural motion. Existing chunk-wise autoregressive methods face challenges in both generation efficiency and long-video quality: serialized denoising and history-cache refresh require two forward passes even with one-step denoising, and longer rollouts can degrade quality and cause camera drift. We propose Wave Forcing (WF), which co-designs generation, training, and execution for continuous video output wi
items.title_cn: 波强制：迈向光速级流式视频生成
items.note: 提出Wave Forcing，协同设计生成、训练与执行，实现连续视频输出并提升长视频质量。

items.title_en: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
items.summary: Rapid advances in cowork agents are shifting human-AI collaboration toward real-world automation, delivering software, designs, and other artifacts. However, such productivity work demands both high-quality delivery on complex productivity tasks and continued monitoring and decision-making over long horizons, a combination that remains an open challenge. We introduce CoworkOS, a general-purpose harness for long-horizon work that separates task strategy from execution management: the model decide
items.title_cn: CoworkOS：扩展智能体同事以实现真实世界自动化
items.note: 提出通用长周期工作框架，把任务策略与执行管理分离，以支持复杂生产力任务。

items.title_en: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
items.summary: Despite recent advances in CUAs, their development remains constrained by the limited diversity, controllability, and reliability of interaction data. Moreover, conventional optimization pipelines lack iterative feedback, while existing recursive improvement approaches often rely on self-generated experiences, limiting ability expansion and yielding diminishing returns. To address these challenges, we introduce CUA-Master, a nested double-loop recursive improvement framework. At the system level
items.title_cn: CUA-Master：通过开放世界递归改进扩展电脑使用智能体
items.note: 提出嵌套双环递归改进框架，缓解电脑使用智能体交互数据多样性和可靠性不足的问题。

items.title_en: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: Video generation is shifting from end-to-end synthesis toward agentic generation, where planning, tool use, and feedback enable coherent, controllable multi-shot videos. In parallel, video world models provide action-conditioned observations and predicted futures, serving as interactive environments for agents. We study their intersection through the agent harness: an executable runtime that constructs context, exposes tools, maintains state, routes feedback, and manages budgets around video mod
items.title_cn: 视频生成遇上智能体框架：智能体视频生成、世界建模与递归自我改进
items.note: 从智能体运行框架角度，研究视频生成与世界模型如何结合并支持递归自我改进。

items.title_en: Does Scaling Toward AGI Depend on What System-1 Lets System-2 Execute?
items.summary: Progress toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) has largely relied on scaling a resource-intensive executive, System-2, through larger models, more data and compute, longer reasoning, and more agents. We ask whether the next stage may come instead from co-designing it with System-1, a lightweight, semantically aware predictor that evaluates candidate interactions before execution, so that System-2 acts only on those worth their cost. Our answer is a qualified yes. We study conditional inte
items.title_cn: 迈向AGI的扩展是否取决于System-1让System-2执行什么？
items.note: 提出用轻量System-1预判候选交互是否值得执行，让昂贵的System-2只处理高价值动作。

items.title_en: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R^2Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrat
items.title_cn: R^2Orch：通过技能内化循环中的自博弈实现智能体编排的递归自我改进
items.note: 提出递归自博弈编排方法，应对手工课程、优势塌缩和评估信号不可靠等问题。

items.title_en: Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models
items.summary: Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) achieve remarkable success on diverse multimodal understanding and generation tasks, yet they still struggle to effectively leverage language-based chain-of-thought reasoning for image generation. As a result, existing reasoning-augmented UMMs often fail to inherit the test-time scaling and fine-grained controllability observed in large language models. We attribute this failure to a fundamental modality mismatch: reasoning is performed in a discrete token space,
items.title_cn: 统一多模态模型中连续空间的潜在推理
items.note: 指出离散词元推理与图像生成存在模态错配，探索在连续空间中进行潜在推理。

items.title_en: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a sep
items.title_cn: Apriel Voice 27B预览：面向语音、推理与工具使用的开放模型
items.note: 提出开放语音语言模型，在共享推理主干上统一语音理解、推理、对话和工具调用。

items.title_en: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visu
items.title_cn: FrameForge：利用视频基础模型先验的统一图像生成
items.note: 利用预训练视频模型编码视觉变换的先验，改进统一条件图像生成。

items.title_en: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.summary: Diffusion vision-language models (DVLMs) process their entire input at every denoising step. Since visual tokens make up 89-97% of this input on the benchmarks we study, most of the decoding computation is spent repeatedly processing the same image. Visual token pruning methods partially relieve this burden by removing part of the visual tokens, but they lose the removed information and still process the remaining image at every step. To measure how often the image is actually needed, we compare
items.title_cn: 需要时才看：面向高效扩散VLM的证书引导视觉路由
items.note: 发现扩散视觉语言模型反复处理图像开销大，提出按需路由视觉信息以减少计算。

items.title_en: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
items.summary: We present Youtu-Parsing-Omni, an omni-modal parser that converts documents, images, audio, and video into structured records grounded in space and time, providing a perception layer for agents that read, locate, and cite evidence across modalities. Its design rests on one encoder for every modality and one schema for every task. Youtu-Omni-Encoder, initialized from a pre-trained language model to strengthen text reading, encodes all modalities with shared weights in a unified space-time coordin
items.title_cn: Youtu-Parsing-Omni：一个编码器、一套模式、全部模态
items.note: 提出全模态解析器，把文档、图像、音频和视频转为带时空定位的结构化记录。

items.title_en: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
items.summary: Recursive self-improvement requires models not only to acquire useful training experience, but also to decide when their current experience has ceased to be useful. Existing methods often focus on what experience to generate next, while paying less attention to when fresh experience should be introduced. Many also construct training targets through self-consistency or majority voting, making supervision depend on the model's own uncertain predictions. We address these two questions separately: t
items.title_cn: A-RSI：面向零数据多模态自我改进的自适应任务刷新
items.note: 研究递归自我改进中何时引入新经验，并减少对模型自身不确定预测的监督依赖。

items.title_en: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation wh
items.title_cn: 用JEPA证明并改进柏拉图表示假说
items.note: 把柏拉图表示假说转为定理，证明分别训练于多模态的JEPA可学到仅差旋转的相同表示。

items.title_en: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
items.summary: Interactive world models generate visual content conditioned on user actions, yet maintaining spatial consistency over long-horizon exploration in real time remains challenging. Existing approaches rely on either temporal context or explicit 3D memory, both of which scale poorly because memory grows with the length of the generated stream. Moreover, explicit 3D memories condition latent video generators by re-encoding RGB renderings, which precludes real-time generation. In this paper, we introd
items.title_cn: L3G-World：基于潜在3D高斯记忆的实时无限世界生成
items.note: 提出潜在3D高斯记忆，解决交互式世界模型长时探索中的空间一致性与实时性问题。

items.title_en: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.summary: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do n
items.title_cn: OmniShowcase：从多视角图像生成全向主体一致视频
items.note: 利用多视角参考图像提供主体不同视角信息，生成视角变化下主体一致的视频。

items.title_en: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.summary: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets
items.title_cn: 面向真实声学场景的高效流式视听目标说话人提取
items.note: 针对真实场景干扰和边缘部署，研究低延迟、轻量的流式视听目标说话人提取。

items.title_en: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.summary: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term too
items.title_cn: TAO：面向LLM智能体服务的工具感知联合调度
items.note: 提出工具感知的联合调度框架，把工具返回就绪情况纳入智能体服务的资源调度。

items.title_en: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
items.summary: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, op
items.title_cn: RealCLI：面向CLI智能体的人机协作统一评估
items.note: 提出配对基准，在真实命令行任务上同时评估任务执行和运行中的人机协作质量。

items.title_en: PersonaCUABench: Benchmarking Computer-Use Agents Serving Diverse Personas
items.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are commonly evaluated against fixed task specifications, but users may omit requirements, add constraints, or require approval before consequential actions. Completing the benchmark instruction does not guarantee serving the person who asked. We introduce PersonaCUABench, which holds 74 tasks across 11 domains fixed and varies only who asks. A persona agent, playing one of 44 personas in four groups, rewrites each instruction in that user's own words and answers the C
items.title_cn: PersonaCUABench：评估服务多元用户画像的电脑使用智能体
items.note: 固定74个任务、只改变提问者画像，评估电脑使用智能体是否真正服务具体用户。

items.title_en: PDRVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model with Physical Dynamics Representations
items.summary: Vision--Language--Action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions, but their understanding of physical dynamics remains limited. Video world models can capture scene dynamics, yet generating future videos introduces high latency into the control loop. We introduce PDRVLA, whose lightweight Physical Dynamics Module extracts physical tokens from vision--language features to condition action generation without online video generation. The module learns
items.title_cn: PDRVLA：带物理动态表示的视觉-语言-动作模型
items.note: 用轻量物理动态模块从视觉语言特征提取物理词元来条件化动作生成，避免在线视频生成。

items.title_en: Hy-Nomas: Towards Free-form Interactive World Generation
items.summary: Interactive world generation requires models to follow successive commands while preserving relevant history and action consequences. We present Hy-Nomas, a video world model with an 8B diffusion backbone that supports free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns. It generates variable-length segments conditioned on current inputs and cached history. Our central design aligns structured video captions with action-aware causal attention: descriptive
items.title_cn: Hy-Nomas：迈向自由形式交互式世界生成
items.note: 提出8B扩散视频世界模型，支持自由文本指令和多轮连续相机控制的交互生成。

items.title_en: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
items.summary: Multimodal intelligence can be viewed as human-guided co-evolution between worlds and agents through interaction. However, scaling this process faces two bottlenecks: constructing heterogeneous, verifiable environments is costly, and manual Harness iteration cannot keep pace with growing task diversity and complexity. A key insight is that tasks with different modalities and surface forms can share the same underlying capability requirements. We therefore introduce The Trinity, a recursive self-
items.title_cn: 三位一体：面向多模态智能体的能力驱动递归自我改进
items.note: 提出能力驱动的递归自我改进方法，缓解异构可验证环境构建成本高的问题。

items.title_en: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
items.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strength
items.title_cn: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化链式动态推理
items.note: 提出VLA学习框架，把动作推理建立在世界动态上，并利用人类视频拓宽经验来源。

items.title_en: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
items.summary: Action-conditioned world models offer a scalable alternative to costly real-world interaction for improving robot policies. However, existing world-model-based methods largely treat world models as forward-only surrogates of the physical environment, leaving untapped a capability no physical environment affords: rewinding to past decision points to explore counterfactual futures. We introduce Rollback, a policy improvement paradigm that turns world models from passive simulators into counterfact
items.title_cn: 回滚：世界模型中用于策略改进的经验回溯
items.note: 提出Rollback范式，让世界模型回退到过去决策点探索反事实未来，以改进机器人策略。

items.title_en: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
items.summary: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver
items.title_cn: 工作智能体：系统、能力与优化
items.note: 从系统层面把工作智能体视为基础模型与运行时框架的组合，梳理其能力与优化。

items.title_en: StreamVibe: Proactive Video Agents for Evolving User Intent
items.summary: Vision-language models are shifting from offline passive understanding toward online proactive interaction. However, prevailing methods largely rely on explicit requests while miss the implicit user intent (e.g., "where should I click next?" while a user navigate a website), meanwhile fail to update the state simultaneously as user requests might update continuously. These limitations make them less suited to intent-aware interaction in practical. To address these challenges, we introduce Stream
items.title_cn: StreamVibe：面向演化用户意图的主动视频智能体
items.note: 提出主动视频智能体，关注隐含用户意图并随请求持续更新状态，而非只靠显式指令。

items.title_en: InteractiveWorld: A Verifiable Human-Centric Environment for Building Better Interactive MLLM Assistants
items.summary: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a ke
items.title_cn: InteractiveWorld：构建更好交互式多模态助手的可验证人本环境
items.note: 提出可验证的人本环境，用于测试可穿戴设备上多模态大模型助手的交互能力。

items.title_en: Spatial Audio Generation and Editing with Executable Plans and Self-Distilling Transfusion
items.summary: Spatial audio authoring coordinates source decisions with soundfield synthesis. For editing, plans specify what to change and retain, while reference audio supplies further acoustic detail. We present AMBIT, a unified framework for native First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) generation and editing with three connected contributions. First, a shared Transfusion backbone couples autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering through executable ScenePlans that specify source content, activity, and 3
items.title_cn: 基于可执行计划与自蒸馏Transfusion的空间音频生成与编辑
items.note: 提出AMBIT统一框架，用可执行场景计划和自蒸馏Transfusion做空间音频生成与编辑。

items.title_en: WorldCast: World-Consistent Character Video Generation with Large-Angle Camera Control
items.summary: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset
items.title_cn: WorldCast：大角度相机控制下的世界一致角色视频生成
items.note: 提出支持大角度相机轨迹的角色视频生成方法，并构建角色中心数据集CLACT。

huggingface.models_summary: 这几个热门模型反映出两个方向：一是模型越来越大、越来越偏向图文多模态，能同时处理图片和文字；二是也有像1.7B这样的小模型和浏览器本地运行方案，强调轻量。对跟进AI圈和备考的人来说，值得注意多模态已成主流，同时要区分“模型”和“应用”，看模型页时先确认任务类型和是否有说明，别只看名字猜能力。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文集中在智能体系统、视频与世界模型、多模态推理三大方向。热门词包括：智能体编排、递归自我改进、世界模型、视频生成、视觉-语言-动作模型、多模态统一表示、推理压缩。新手可记住：AI正从单个大模型转向“模型+工具+运行时”的系统协作，同时用世界模型和视频生成让智能体理解并预测环境。
